name: Ishino Makoto
source:
“Your expression changed, huh. Are you scared of the police?”

A freelance cameraman and friend of Kentarou. He’s suspicious of Makihara following Kentarou’s disappearance. He’s good with words, and it’s difficult to read what he’s really thinking.

[Source: [url=http://www.tarhs.com/chara.html]official website profile[/url]]
